canDoYue: 你識打電話叫外賣、報地址、串街名，同埋問幾耐同送到先畀錢。
canDoEn: Order a takeaway by phone, give an address, spell the street, and ask about the delivery time and paying on delivery.

dialogue.speaker: lina
dialogue.text: I would like to order one hot chicken takeaway for delivery to my office, please.
dialogue.glossYue: 我想叫一份熱雞外賣，送到我公司。
dialogue.say: I would like to order one hot chicken takeaway for delivery to my office, please.

dialogue.speaker: pesi
dialogue.text: What is the full street address for this chicken delivery from our shop this afternoon?
dialogue.glossYue: 今午呢份雞由我哋舖頭送，請講完整街道地址。
dialogue.say: What is the full street address for this chicken delivery from our shop this afternoon?

dialogue.speaker: lina
dialogue.text: Please note the address is eighteen Harbour Street, and I spell Harbour as H A R B O U R.
dialogue.glossYue: 地址係十八號 Harbour Street，Harbour 串做 H A R B O U R。
dialogue.say: Please note the address is eighteen Harbour Street, and I spell Harbour as H A R B O U R.

dialogue.speaker: lina
dialogue.text: How long will the rider take to bring this hot delivery to my office?
dialogue.glossYue: 騎手要幾耐先將呢份熱外賣送到我公司？
dialogue.say: How long will the rider take to bring this hot delivery to my office?

dialogue.speaker: pesi
dialogue.text: The rider will arrive in about twenty minutes with the hot chicken takeaway.
dialogue.glossYue: 騎手大約二十分鐘送到熱雞外賣。
dialogue.say: The rider will arrive in about twenty minutes with the hot chicken takeaway.

dialogue.speaker: lina
dialogue.text: How can I pay for the chicken takeaway when it reaches the office door?
dialogue.glossYue: 雞外賣送到公司門口，我點樣付款？
dialogue.say: How can I pay for the chicken takeaway when it reaches the office door?

dialogue.speaker: pesi
dialogue.text: You can pay on delivery in cash only when the takeaway reaches your front door.
dialogue.glossYue: 你可以送到先畀現金，送到門口先畀。
dialogue.say: You can pay on delivery in cash only when the takeaway reaches your front door.

dialogue.speaker: lina
dialogue.text: Thank you. I will wait quietly at the office door until the hot chicken arrives.
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。我會喺公司門口靜靜等熱雞送到。
dialogue.say: Thank you. I will wait quietly at the office door until the hot chicken arrives.

understand.prompt: I would like to order one hot chicken takeaway for delivery to my office, please. 呢句即係點？
choices: 我想叫熱雞外賣送到公司
我想叫熱雞外賣但唔使送到
我想改外賣地址，唔係叫雞
understand.explain: takeaway 係外賣。delivery 係送到。

understand.prompt: Please note the address is eighteen Harbour Street, and I spell Harbour as H A R B O U R. 呢句即係點？
choices: 請講送到時間，唔係地址
請用現金付款，唔使講地址
請講街道地址，再串街名

understand.prompt: How can I pay for the chicken takeaway when it reaches the office door? 即係問緊咩？
